message.content:
## What this is and why it matters for «говорити»
«Говори́ти» is the everyday verb for speaking and talking, and its present and future forms are the second-conjugation pattern you can reuse for dozens of verbs. Its endings differ from those of «чита́ти», which is first conjugation.

## The pattern
Take the stem «говор-» and add the second-conjugation endings: -ю́ in the first person, then -и́ш, -и́ть, -и́мо, -и́те, and -я́ть. The third-person plural is -ять, not -ють, which is the quickest sign of the second conjugation. The stress sits on the ending in every present form. The imperfective future is built with the auxiliary «бу́ду» plus the infinitive and never changes the stem. Unlike «хо́дити → хожу́», this verb has no consonant alternation in the first person.

## The forms
| Person | Present | Future |
|---|---|---|
| я | говорю́ | бу́ду говори́ти |
| ти | говори́ш | бу́деш говори́ти |
| він / вона / воно | говори́ть | бу́де говори́ти |
| ми | говори́мо | бу́демо говори́ти |
| ви | говори́те | бу́дете говори́ти |
| вони | говоря́ть | бу́дуть говори́ти |

## In the wild
- Вона́ говори́ть ти́хо, але́ ясно. → She speaks quietly but clearly. → «говори́ть», third person singular present: one person, a habit or a current state.
- За́втра я бу́ду говори́ти з дире́ктором. → Tomorrow I will be talking to the director. → «бу́ду говори́ти», compound future: the talking is a process, not a single act.
- Ми говори́мо украї́нською вдо́ма. → We speak Ukrainian at home. → «говори́мо», first person plural present: a regular practice.

## Watch out
- Do not write «говорять» with -ють; the second conjugation uses -ять.
- «Говори́ти» has no one-word future; use «бу́ду говори́ти», or switch to the perfective «ска́жу».
- The polite singular «Ви говори́те» takes the plural ending, even when you address one person.
Memory hook: second conjugation = -иш / -ить in the middle and -ять at the end of the plural.

## Check yourself
1. How do you say «they speak» in Ukrainian?
2. Which auxiliary builds the future of an imperfective verb?
3. What is the form of «говори́ти» for «you (ви) speak»?

---
1. Вони́ говоря́ть.
2. «Бу́ти» (бу́ду, бу́деш, …) plus the infinitive.
3. Ви говори́те.
